pages.title: Dawn Armor
pages.text: §lAcquisition: §r Smith at a Smithing Table with a Dawn Template + the corresponding iron armor piece + an iron ingot. Each of the four pieces is forged separately.$(br)The Dawn Template drops randomly from loot chests (see its entry for details).$(br2)§lAttributes: §r Significantly higher armor value, armor toughness, and knockback resistance than iron. Each piece comes pre-enchanted with all protection variants and Durability Boost II, with a durability cap of 250.$(br2)§lLayout: §r$(br)Template slot: Dawn Template$(br)Base slot: Iron Helmet / Iron Chestplate / Iron Leggings / Iron Boots$(br)Addition slot: Iron Ingot

pages.title: Dawn Helmet
pages.text: Requires: Dawn Template + Iron Helmet + Iron Ingot. Armor 3, pre-enchanted with all protection variants and Durability Boost II.

pages.title: Dawn Chestplate
pages.text: Requires: Dawn Template + Iron Chestplate + Iron Ingot. Armor 10, pre-enchanted with all protection variants and Durability Boost II.

pages.title: Dawn Leggings
pages.text: Requires: Dawn Template + Iron Leggings + Iron Ingot. Armor 8, pre-enchanted with all protection variants and Durability Boost II.

pages.title: Dawn Boots
pages.text: Requires: Dawn Template + Iron Boots + Iron Ingot. Armor 4, pre-enchanted with all protection variants and Durability Boost II.
